card.line: The Jabbok is a stream east of the Jordan River where Jacob wrestled and was renamed Israel, and later a border for Israel and the Ammonites.

moments.title: Jacob crosses the ford
moments.text: During the night Jacob took his wives, maidservants, and eleven sons and crossed the ford of the Jabbok. He sent them across the stream with all his possessions.

moments.title: Israel takes Sihon's land
moments.text: Israel defeated Sihon and took his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok. They stopped at the border of the Ammonites, because it was fortified.

moments.title: Land the LORD forbade
moments.text: Moses reminded Israel that they did not go near the land along the banks of the Jabbok River. The LORD had forbidden it.

moments.title: A border for the tribes
moments.text: Moses gave the Reubenites and Gadites land from Gilead to the Arnon Valley and up to the Jabbok River, the border of the Ammonites.

moments.title: Jephthah answers the Ammonites
moments.text: The Ammonite king said Israel had seized his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok. Jephthah replied that the LORD gave Israel all that land from the Amorites.
